newsitem.title: USA: California Micro sells digital radio unit.
newsitem.headline: California Micro sells digital radio unit.

text.p: California Microwave Inc said on Tuesday it sold its Digital Radio Technology Inc unit to Harris Corp.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

Philip Otto, California Microwave's chairman and chief executive officer, said in a statement that the business "was not a good fit with our strategic plans. The divestiture of DRT will allow California Microwave to focus more fully on its core businesses."

Digital Radio was founded in 1994 to pursue opportunities in air-to-ground communications systems using digital radios. California Microwave began funding the business in 1995 and purchased a majority interest in the company that same year.
California Microwave is a supplier of telecommunications satellite earth stations and microwave radios used in wireless communications.
